description: This PHP class 'ImageAttachmentController' handles HTTP requests related to image attachments in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It retrieves specific images based on request attributes and prepares HTTP responses with appropriate headers and content.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling image attachment requests and returning image content with appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method processing the incoming request, retrieving the image based on request attributes, and returning a properly configured HTTP response.
